title: Bank starting state
statement: Given a natural number $d$, a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$, and an index $j<d$, define the bank's starting cleaning state to be the initialization state tagged with the pair consisting of $j$ and the initial state of the $j$th machine.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $d$ and a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$
